messages:
sara: Heads-up — bringing up model v3-int8 in canary today. I'm proposing an 'introspective' canary gate that combines quality deltas (embedding-sim drop + human-flag rate) with perf regressions (p95 latency, error rate). If the composite score > 0.6 we auto-fallback. Thoughts?

oz: Curious — can you specify how the composite score is computed? we need something auditable for postmortems. :eyes:

sara: Sure. Quick sketch: composite = w1 * norm(embed_drop) + w2 * norm(human_flag_rate) + w3 * norm(latency_regress) + w4 * norm(error_rate). Each norm maps to 0..1 using precomputed historical ranges. Default weights: w1=0.4, w2=0.3, w3=0.2, w4=0.1. fallback if composite >= 0.6 AND sample_n >= 50 in last 15m.

mallory: I like the sample_n guard. Also prefer rolling-window MA over 30m for signal smoothing so noisy bursts don't trigger. And require at least 10 flagged diffs for human review before committing to permanent rollback.

canary-bot: smoke run results: sample_n=200, embed_drop_mean=0.048, human_flag_rate=0.012, p95_latency_delta=+14ms, 5xx_rate_delta=0.002. composite=0.52 -> no auto-fallback (below 0.6).

nate: embed_drop 0.048 is borderline but p95 +14ms is workable. My suggestion: add a hard circuit-breaker for latency-only regressions: if p95_delta > 30ms OR error_rate_delta > 0.01 => immediate fallback regardless of composite. Keeps availability protected.

sara: Good call. Also proposing a 'graded rollback' path: auto-fallback -> route to v2 for 90% traffic, v3 shadowed for 10% until human review clears. That avoids flip-flop.

oz: For auditing, log the raw signals and the normalized contributions per decision. Add a simple human-readable reason string: e.g., "composite:0.65(embed:0.3, human:0.25, lat:0.08, err:0.02)"

mallory: +1 to the audit string. Also add a short-run human eval harness that surfaces examples that drove the human_flag_rate so reviewers can triage quickly.

canary-bot: example failure buckets (top 3): 1) truncated code completions (34%), 2) date hallucinations (27%), 3) formatting loss on bullets (18%). Attaching random sample ids: s_1023, s_1102, s_1157.

sara: Proposed policy YAML (for infra team):
```
canary_policy:
  name: introspective-v3-int8
  sample_window_minutes: 15
  min_samples: 50
  smoothing_minutes: 30
  weights: {embed:0.4, human:0.3, latency:0.2, error:0.1}
  composite_threshold: 0.6
  hard_breakers: {p95_latency_ms:30, error_rate:0.01}
  rollback_mode: graded
  graded_split: {fallback:0.9, shadow:0.1}
  audit_log: true
```

nate: Nice. Can we also expose a per-session TTL for rolling back the fallback if metrics cool off? e.g., hold fallback for at least 10 minutes before automatic re-promote, and require composite < 0.4 for 20m to re-open.

sara: Yup — add cooldowns. I'll update the YAML and open a PR against infra-config. Action items: sara -> PR with policy + unit tests; mallory -> quick human review harness; oz -> logging spec for audit string; nate -> perf hard-breaker integration.

mallory: I'll mock up the harness UI snippets tomorrow.

oz: I'll draft the log schema and correlation ids so we can trace decisions back to request samples.

canary-bot: scheduled: deploy canary 1725554600 -> results will stream to #eng-ml.

sara: thanks team — we'll monitor metrics in Console and I'll ping if anything hits the breakers. :thumbsup:
